title: Kernel triangle of the stupid tail under an exact functor
statement: Let C,D be abelian categories with derived categories and R:C to D an additive exact functor [def-sp-abelian, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let K be an integer cochain complex, and suppose R(K) is exact in all degrees at most r. Set T to the stupid tail of K in degrees at least r and M to the kernel of R(d^r). There exist morphisms making a distinguished triangle single(M,r) to D(R)(Q(T)) to D(R)(Q(K)) to single(M,r)[1] [def-weil-triangulated-category]. No boundedness, finiteness, or perfectness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08EG, proof of Lemma 36.13.6, finite-free lift and stupid truncation; read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08EG

proof.text: Construct the inclusion of the explicit stupid tail T into K from the termwise truncation isomorphisms above r and zero maps below r. The complex shape and zero source in discarded degrees prove that it commutes with differentials. Map it by R, giving j:S to L with isomorphisms in each degree at least r.

The canonical good-truncation sequence S.truncLE(r) to S to B is degreewise short exact. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle]. The first complex has support exactly in degree r: its term there is cycles(S,r). The kernel universal property and j in degrees r,r+1 identify this term with M. Evaluate the single-complex isomorphism and map it to the derived category.

The canonical map B to S.truncGE(r+1) is a quasi-isomorphism. The map induced by j from this good truncation to L.truncGE(r+1) is a quasi-isomorphism, since all three components computing homology in each degree above r are isomorphisms. Exactness through r makes the projection L to L.truncGE(r+1) a quasi-isomorphism. Compose these isomorphisms after localization and the exact-functor comparison to identify B with D(R)(Q(K)); identify the middle term similarly. Conjugate all three arrows of the SES triangle by these isomorphisms and use isomorphic_distinguished. This is implemented entirely in Lean with Mathlib truncation and kernel lemmas.

theorem exactFunctor_stupidTail_triangle
    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] [Abelian C]
    {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D] [Abelian D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} D]
    (R : C ⥤ D) [R.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits R] [PreservesFiniteColimits R]
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (r : ℤ)
    (hexact : ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ r →
      ((R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K).ExactAt i) :
    ∃ (i : (singleFunctor D r).obj (kernel (R.map (K.d r (r + 1)))) ⟶
          R.mapDerivedCategory.obj (Q.obj (K.stupidTrunc (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE r))))
      (p : R.mapDerivedCategory.obj (Q.obj
          (K.stupidTrunc (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE r))) ⟶ R.mapDerivedCategory.obj (Q.obj K))
      (δ : R.mapDerivedCategory.obj (Q.obj K) ⟶
          ((singleFunctor D r).obj (kernel (R.map (K.d r (r + 1)))))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk i p δ ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory D)
